verdict: For invoices with more than about 150 to 200 line items. Single pass got almost none of the line items right on the RealKIE invoices with 182 or more items (line-item score 0.00 to 0.50, and 0 on the invoices with 309, 392 and 1,490 items); iterative extraction got 0.32 to 0.90 on the same invoices. Below that size single pass did better and cost less: across all 20 RealKIE invoices its line-item score was 0.61 against 0.45. Iterative extraction did not finish the 1,490-item invoice within Test Studio's time limit.
